text: search hygiene: one repo-wide grep ('awaiting stowage|outbound return') early on printed 3 lines from held-out material: SRB lunar_base_mission_b/task.py comments (occupier: outbound return container at the habitat; status text) and experiments/scenarios/mission_b/held_out/b_l2_destination_occupied_habitat{,.certificate}.yaml (occupier on the habitat stand, must be cleared to some other support). No content beyond the brief; files not opened; searches kept to allowed dirs since.

modelling error 1: first capacity model (Support.slot Free/Occupied, pick met_by Occupied + meets Free, place met_by Free + meets Occupied) makes the default solver search blow up even on the covered delivery (5000 steps unsolved vs 118): pick's slot effect is resolved before its item-location condition binds the support, so the slot/object is guessed (first = pdu_1_shelf) and the solver recurses into invented place/pick chains. Offline, planner-only check (no live run).

modelling error 2: alternatives tried offline (planner-only): pick support bound from the record; flaw priorities deferring Slot flaws (PlannerConfig); guards deferring slot tokens (a guarded effect is not registered as an action effect, so the capacity was silently not enforced); Held->On(return stand) rule; occupancy as slaves of item stays. Findings: a nested guard on a parameter's member (support.returns == false) never fires; stays-only occupancy let the solver place onto the stand in the same instant the occupant was lifted (fixed: place occupies the support for its own duration); DFS still picks the delivery item first and does not recover within 5000 steps.

modelling error 3 (and decision): a domain-only derivation (capacity + 'an outbound return awaiting stowage rests on the return stand' rule) is correct (the stowage alone solves in 189 steps, the delivery alone in ~175) but EUROPA's default chronological search does not find the interleaved plan (5000 and 60000 steps; also crashes in EUROPA's token discard when rules relate two slaves). Chosen: the domain models the capacity; the host puts the record's pending stowage ahead of the mission goals (one goal per solve). Offline chain then exposed a frozen-baseline hole: the solver horizon starts at the facts (t=0), so the HorizonFilter (PartiallyContained) never checks the conditions of an activity that can start at once -- plan 2 picked the consumables container at the return stand where the rover stood. Fixed: planner horizon opens at -1.

offline chain (sim_boundary --outbound RTN-0007=habitat_stand/slot_0, docker --network none): L2-B done in 4 plans (stow RTN-0007 habitat->return stand; CNS-0301 landing->habitat; stow; dock), 15 dispatches; with pick:1 and place:2 failing: replans repeat the same call, done; covered regressions done: consumables->habitat, ORU->PDU-1 shelf (9 dispatches each), Mission A pdu_2 (5).
